title: Assess exact AAFC source fit for seven Arctic physical gap components

labels.name: status:blocked
labels.description: Dependency or geography/access decision prevents claiming

labels.name: type:geography

body:
Parent campaign: #1202. Exact source-fit subset selected from #1295; prior GSHHG source-relative comparator is #1261, numerical closure diagnosis is #1270, and AAFC source evidence is retained by #457. #887 is related context only: that issue covers 114 Arctic locations against territorial boundaries and does not answer this exact component-level source-envelope/no-loss question.

## Scope

Assess only these seven source-backed candidate components from the two complete families; retain all four-family / 64-component and complete target/neighbor context in the evidence:

- ECO15, current target `atlas:physical:CAN-15:NWT` (Banks Island Lowland), parent framework group Victoria Lowlands:
  - `physical-component:12c9ec9813490ce8602fb26ee2e54225b99c28bbd29794a7f8ac9ee60f109e8a`
  - `physical-component:52452c5923a0ed15767ebdf150727924778349b7d9ba4370b616d1d70c0ccddd`
- ECO25, current target `atlas:physical:CAN-25:NUN` (Foxe Basin Plain), parent framework group Foxe–Boothia Lowlands:
  - `physical-component:add031b7195352292c8529323c8b99dd75002af629116b229e84be981893ca8d`
  - `physical-component:2aca267603c8eace3a6d0a52d4e3f0b70a47506b94d2ea9e1d500e43aab4632c`
  - `physical-component:265c983a61231e3a5c2cf4bb2f7b97896d47afefe925a9eb85934101a78515a8`
  - `physical-component:17bb5b7f043b0fb2b447b8ccef216e530fed4595da1aec0feb1dea235bed0dbd`
  - `physical-component:54dc96cd3d0edd92ff9d9399d8364e17735d12f11407f707d57912f9f6a66475`

For every candidate, use exact raster/vector geometry predicates against both the native semantic-source edition and retained official AAFC v2.2 where applicable. Inspect its complete target and adjacent member/retired-member context, preserving source edition differences, precision, tolerance and topology limits. A repair-ready recommendation requires all of: candidate wholly contained in exactly one applicable named physical-region envelope; consistent source identity/hierarchy and retired-member context; exact additive candidate geometry; no loss of existing target geometry; and no new overlap with any affected neighbor. Report the exact absent premise for every candidate that fails any criterion.

This is a geometric source-fit proposal only. AAFC ecological regions are not administrative boundaries, and source fit does not establish historic cause, ice/water status, legal boundary authority, publication approval or permission to change geometry. No invented labels or inferred ownership. Preserve #1295 and all source geometry unchanged.

## Acceptance

1. Pin and authenticate original source bytes and target/neighbor input records; include complete original four-family context, not only the seven candidates.
2. Provide reproducible bounded methods and candidate-specific results for each criterion above, with meaningful adverse controls and limitations.
3. Classify each of the seven as either repair-ready source-envelope fit or unresolved, naming the exact missing evidence/fact per unresolved candidate.
4. Provide exact no-loss/no-new-overlap addition geometry only for repair-ready candidates as a proposal, never as a core data modification.
5. Preserve evidence-quality manifest and source/license/vintage/precision notes under the declared owned path.

No browser or new source acquisition; use retained repository evidence only. Do not run a whole-world pipeline, change tracked geography, or close #1295. One PR maximum.
